text: Liquefaction: the potential shall be assessed per TBDY 2018 chapter 16 for the DD-2 event using the CPTu and SPT data; the loose silty sand layer (2.5 m to 9 m below grade) is expected to liquefy. Foundations shall either transfer the loads below the liquefiable layer (piles) or the layer shall be improved (stone columns, deep soil mixing) so that the liquefaction safety factor is not less than 1.2 under DD-2; post-liquefaction settlement and lateral spreading shall be included in the pile design (kinematic loads, loss of skin friction in the liquefied layer).
